cycles.title: ACP Intervention Demo Cycle
cycles.prompt: In a crowded fellowship workspace, how should ACP surface the strongest next action without losing the supporting thread?
operator_notes: This cycle demonstrates ACP intervention behavior with a routed digest layer.
Release should expose the digest and explain why items were elevated.

cycles.title: ACP Baseline Thread Demo Cycle
cycles.prompt: In a crowded fellowship workspace, what next step should the group take after the latest update?
operator_notes: This cycle demonstrates the baseline thread condition without routing.
Item order should remain chronological and easy to inspect.
